title: 第23章 沉香木第24章 大项目
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
“这事难度不小啊，最大的难关就是找到合适的木材……”
跟童元安解释了一些具体难处后，佘玉瑶松了口气，估计这样他应该死心了。
但接着童元安的回答，却让她目瞪口呆。
“放心吧，材料我已经搞定了，我这就用微信给你发一些照片看看是否够用。”
讲完这番话，童元安结束了通话，并立刻给佘玉瑶发送了几张木材图片。
此刻的佘玉瑶并不当回事，以为童元安家中可能承包了一片林子所以才萌生此想法。
无奈地摇摇头，真是天真的念头。
“滴滴！”
拿起平板电脑打开微信，一见那些照片顿时让她震撼不已。
“我的天！
怎么会这样？”
用力搓了搓眼睛再三确认，这才敢相信所见属实。
作为一名从小接触家族木工艺知识的人来说，她对木材的理解远超常人。
而童元安分享的照片，其中展示的是非常罕见且珍贵的木材种类。
大量竟是上好的金丝楠木，按其大小推测，肯定有很长树龄，自己也是头回见到如此珍贵的原木。
如今这世道，这类优质木材的价值甚至超过了黄金玉石。
这么多，少说得值数百亿，而且绝对是可遇不可求的珍品。
“宝贝孙女，在看什么呢，饭做好都不出来吃。”
爷爷慈爱地走进来，对她颇为满意。
聪明又踏实，完全能够继承祖传的手艺。

但现在怎么这么反常？盯着平板愣神儿？
“莫不是有小伙子追你了吧？也该考虑终身大事啦。
若你也喜欢人家……”
爷爷的声音戛然而止，也被屏幕上展示的内容吸引住了。
“嘭！”
“爷爷，没事吧！”
佘玉瑶立刻站起身去搀扶爷爷。
万万没想到平时淡定的爷爷，此时竟激动得几乎失控。
“让我仔细瞧瞧照片。”
接过平板凝视着那些木材图像，仿佛正欣赏无价之宝。
爷爷心中的震惊更甚于她自己。
除了金丝楠木之外，还有很多沉香木！
清晰细腻的纹理加上自然形成的色泽与粗大的树干。
这些都是纯野生的老沉香木，价值难以估量。
沉香木不光是一种高档建筑材料，还因为其香料及药用功效更加名贵。
尤其是未加处理的野生沉香木，更是物以稀为贵。
据保守估计，仅仅从那几幅照片来看，总值已逾上千亿！
“爷爷你没事儿吧？”
佘玉瑶担心地看着爷爷，记忆中他从未如此震惊过。
看着他愈发痴迷的眼神和加重的喘息声，只愿千万别有什么不好发生。

好在，老人家的情绪慢慢平静下来。
长舒一口气，用力合上平板电脑，却发现衣服已经被汗水湿透。
“哎呀”
content_en:
"This is quite difficult. The biggest difficulty is finding the right wood..."
After explaining some specific difficulties to Tong Yuanan, She Yuyao breathed a sigh of relief. He probably should have given up.
But then Tong Yuanan's answer left her stunned.
"Don't worry, I've got the materials. I'll send you some photos via WeChat to see if they're enough."
After saying this, Tong Yuanan ended the call and immediately sent several pictures of wood to She Yuyao.
At this moment, She Yuyao didn't take it seriously, thinking that Tong Yuanan's family might have contracted a piece of forest, so she came up with this idea.
无奈地摇摇头，真是天真的念头。
"Didi!"
She picked up her tablet and opened WeChat, and was shocked when she saw those photos.
"Oh my God!
How could this happen? "
I rubbed my eyes hard to confirm again, and then I dared to believe that what I saw was true.
As someone who has been exposed to family woodcraft knowledge since childhood, her understanding of wood is far beyond ordinary people.
The photos shared by Tong Yuanan show very rare and precious wood species.
A large number of them are actually fine golden nanmu. Judging from their size, they must be very old. This is the first time I have seen such precious logs.
In today's world, the value of this kind of high-quality wood even exceeds that of gold and jade.
So much, it is worth tens of billions to say the least, and it is definitely a rare treasure.
"My dear granddaughter, what are you looking at? You don't even come out to eat when the meal is ready."
爷爷慈爱地走进来，对她颇为满意。
Smart and down-to-earth, he is fully capable of inheriting the skills passed down from his ancestors.
但现在怎么这么反常？ Staring at your tablet in a daze?
"Is there a young man chasing you? It's time to think about life-long matters.
若你也喜欢人家……”
Grandpa's voice stopped suddenly, and he was also attracted by the content displayed on the screen.
"Bang!"
“爷爷，没事吧！”
佘玉瑶立刻站起身去搀扶爷爷。
He never expected that his usually calm grandfather would be so excited that he almost lost control.
“让我仔细瞧瞧照片。”
Take the tablet and stare at the wood images, as if you are admiring a priceless treasure.
爷爷心中的震惊更甚于她自己。
In addition to golden nanmu, there are also a lot of agarwood!
Clear and delicate texture combined with naturally formed color and thick trunk.
These are pure wild old agarwood, and their value is inestimable.
Agarwood is not only a high-end building material, but also more valuable because of its spices and medicinal properties.
Especially untreated wild agarwood is rare and extremely valuable.
According to conservative estimates, just from those few photos, the total value has exceeded hundreds of billions!
“爷爷你没事儿吧？”
She Yuyao looked at her grandfather worriedly. He had never been so shocked in his memory.
Seeing his increasingly obsessed eyes and heavier breathing, I just hoped that nothing bad would happen.
好在，老人家的情绪慢慢平静下来。
He breathed a long sigh of relief and closed the tablet with force, only to find that his clothes were soaked with sweat.
"oops"
